summary: First-finish smoke test of AREVEI backend + frontend. Auth (founder + super admin + signup), site CRUD, versions, team invite, billing, SEO, and super admin overview all work. Two HIGH-priority blockers found: (1) AI /api/ai/chat returns HTTP 500 because EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is exceeded (litellm BadRequestError: 'Max budget: 0.0'); (2) PUT /api/site replaces theme_config wholesale (no deep merge), wiping typography and crashing the public tenant site at /s/northwind-studio with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading heading_font)'. Frontend founder login, dashboard, content editor save+persist, AI Studio page load, versions page, and super admin login all pass.
passed: POST /api/auth/login founder@demo.com returns token + user (role=founder_admin, tenant_id set). Note: response field is 'token', not 'access_token'.
POST /api/auth/login admin@arevei.com returns token + user (role=super_admin, tenant_id=null)
POST /api/auth/signup creates new tenant + site + founder_admin user and returns token
GET /api/site returns seeded site for founder (theme_config, pages, seo) — returns site object directly (no 'site' wrapper)
PUT /api/site updates fields and creates a version snapshot (GET /api/versions now returns rows)
GET /api/versions, POST/restore endpoints exist and list snapshots
GET /api/team lists tenant members; POST /api/team/invite returns {ok:true, temp_password}
GET /api/billing returns tenant + seeded billing records
GET /api/seo returns SEO; PUT /api/seo persists meta updates
GET /api/admin/overview with super_admin returns aggregated MRR/tenants/AI usage
Frontend: /login with founder credentials -> /admin Dashboard with dashboard-stats visible
Frontend: /admin/content edit hero headline + Save persists across reload (field-hero-headline value retained)
Frontend: /admin/ai AI Studio page loads with ai-input/ai-send
Frontend: /admin/versions shows version rows (2 snapshots after edits)
Frontend: /login with admin@arevei.com lands on /super and super-admin element visible

failed.issue: POST /api/ai/chat returns HTTP 500. Root cause from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. The EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env (sk-emergent-840B6EeE1C68526372) has a $0 budget. As a secondary issue, ai_engine.run_ai raises ChatError which is not caught in server.py:286, so the endpoint 500s instead of returning a graceful response with empty proposed_changes.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/ai/chat -> 'Internal Server Error'; backend log shows emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ChatError: 'Max budget: 0.0'

failed.issue: PUT /api/site replaces theme_config with the payload object instead of doing a deep merge. After sending {theme_config:{colors:{...}}}, typography and spacing keys are dropped from the persisted site. This permanently broke the seeded northwind-studio demo until reseeded.
failed.evidence: After PUT, GET /api/site/public/northwind-studio shows theme keys: ['colors'] only (typography/spacing missing).

failed.issue: /s/northwind-studio renders a blank page. Console: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading heading_font)' from <TenantSite>. Component does not defensively guard against missing theme_config.typography. Combined with the destructive PUT above, the live demo site is currently broken.
failed.evidence: Playwright: tenant-site element count=0, body innerText only 'Made with Emergent'. Console log: PAGE ERROR: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'heading_font')

failed.issue: POST /api/ai/apply requires field 'log_id' (not 'session_id') — worth documenting; the AIStudio frontend should pass log_id returned by /api/ai/chat. Not verified end-to-end because /api/ai/chat is currently 500.

action_items: Fix EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget — current key has Max budget: 0.0; obtain a working Emergent LLM key with positive budget, then restart backend.

Make PUT /api/site perform a deep-merge for theme_config (and probably pages/seo) so partial updates don't wipe untouched keys. Also re-seed northwind-studio (run startup re-seed or POST a full theme_config) so the live demo site renders again.
Add defensive defaults in TenantSite.jsx (or all consumers) for theme_config.typography / spacing so a missing key does not crash the page; consider an error boundary on the public site route.
Wrap run_ai in server.py:286 with try/except so AI provider failures return 200 with empty proposed_changes + an assistant_message describing the error, instead of 500.
Verify AIStudio frontend posts log_id (not session_id) to /api/ai/apply once AI chat is working.
test_credentials: Found in /app/memory/test_credentials.md — founder@demo.com / Demo@1234, admin@arevei.com / Admin@1234. Both work.
